2608.28042.title: SimpCue: Cue-Based Prompting for Multilingual Text Simplification
2608.28042.paper_summary: Text simplification aims to make complex texts easier to understand while preserving their original meaning. Recent large language models can perform simplification through prompting, but it remains unclear whether adding explicit linguistic information about sentence complexity to the prompt improves their outputs. We investigate this question for multilingual sentence-level Easy-to-Read simplification in Catalan, Spanish, and Italian. Using Qwen3-8B, we compare a baseline prompt, a gold-cue prompt enriched with gold linguistic cues, and a predicted-cue prompt enriched with automatically predicted cues. We evaluate the outputs using SARI, BLEU, chrF, and BERTScore, and complement this evaluation with a manual qualitative analysis. Predicted-cue prompting obtains the best overall scores across all four metrics, although the gains over the baseline are small. Gold-cue prompting does not consistently improve over the baseline, and results vary across languages. These findings indicate that cue-based prompting can influence multilingual Easy-to-Read simplification, but its benefits are modest, metric-dependent, and language-dependent.
2608.28042.paper_summary_zh: 文本簡化旨在使複雜的文本更易於理解，同時保留其原始意義。最近的大型語言模型可以通過提示進行簡化，但尚不清楚在提示中添加有關句子複雜性的明確語言信息是否能改善其輸出。我們針對加泰羅尼亞語、西班牙語和意大利語的多語言句子級別易讀簡化探討這個問題。使用 Qwen3-8B，我們比較了一個基準提示、一個富含黃金語言提示的黃金提示，以及一個富含自動預測提示的預測提示。我們使用 SARI、BLEU、chrF 和 BERTScore 評估輸出，並用手動定性分析補充這一評估。預測提示在所有四個指標中獲得了最佳的整體分數，儘管相對於基準的增益很小。黃金提示並未在基準上持續改善，且結果在不同語言之間有所變化。這些發現表明，基於提示的提示可以影響多語言易讀簡化，但其好處是適度的，依賴於指標和語言。
